business_problem: Spirit AI needed stable high-performance infrastructure to train embodied AI models efficiently enough for commercial robotics, especially because flexible-object manipulation, long-sequence multimodal training, and rapid model iteration make embodied intelligence unusually compute-intensive.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud provided Spirit AI with an AI Infra stack tuned for embodied-model development so the company could train and iterate its Spirit v1 vision-language-action model efficiently. Spirit AI's core challenge was not only building a model 'brain' for high-level instruction understanding and task planning, but also handling the 'cerebellum' motion-control layer, embodied datasets, and the supporting software and hardware system. Baidu's contribution focused on making cloud compute productive: a stable high-performance AI Infra platform backed Spirit's training jobs, while an associated training-and-inference acceleration suite improved throughput and reduced wasted compute. The platform is also being optimized for long-sequence performance and multimodal training, which matters because Spirit v1 must fuse language, scene perception, and robot action control to solve flexible-object tasks such as folding clothes. This let Spirit move faster from research to commercially relevant embodied-AI scenarios without having to build the whole training substrate from scratch.

data_flow: Natural-language instructions and multimodal environment data are fed into Spirit v1 during cloud training on the AI Infra platform, accelerated training pipelines optimize the model for dynamic-scene perception and action control, and the resulting VLA model drives downstream embodied-AI tasks such as long-horizon flexible-object manipulation.
business_outcome: Spirit AI gained faster and more efficient embodied-model development, improving the practicality of deploying robotics systems in complex real-world scenarios such as manufacturing and service operations.
